headline: Last session: Nifty gained 75 points while Sensex slipped into the red amid volatile trading and mixed global cues.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Geopolitical risks heightened after reports of drone and missile attacks on Saudi Aramco facilities.
Crude oil price volatility and foreign institutional investor (FII) flows remained primary concerns.
Uncertainty ahead of a proposed three-day bank strike prompted caution in banking stocks.
Warnings of potential cyberattack disruptions in the tech and semiconductor ecosystem impacted market mood.
whatHappening: Nifty gained 75 points during the last trading session while Sensex faced pressure.
Paytm and Tata group stocks were in key focus due to corporate developments.
Finance Ministry scheduled discussions with PSB chiefs to manage banking operations during strike days.
Markets are looking ahead to next week support levels with focus on crude oil and global news.

summary:
The Indian stock market ended the last session on a mixed note with Nifty gaining 75 points while Sensex slipped.
Geopolitical friction in the Middle East and upcoming public sector bank strikes created cautious sentiment among participants.
Investors are watching crude oil price trends, FII flows, and global cues for market direction next week.
